posts.description: A couple years ago, I was using #AI tools like #Claude and #Codex alongside #Xcode and Fork for my app development projects. Now, the Claude desktop app is my primary IDE, and I use Fork to decide if I need to open Xcode and adjust. I almost never open Xcode now. It needs to evolve with the times.

With @Meta @Muse and Charms, @OpenAI and Jony Ive’s Dots, and @Apple ’s HomePad (and the later Pixar-inspired articulated AI model), I’m more convinced than ever the movie Her nailed the interface for this next era of computing back in 2013. Voice, an AirPod, and a screen that sees. That’s the UI.

I ignored the Muse app because I know @Meta , but decided to take a look after the latest Dithering. I went in completely skeptical, and when it encouraged me to connect things like my email and bank accounts (!), actually lol’d. I was right to be skeptical. Nice try, @Zuck.
